plan: OpenVibe Updated Plan Based On Codebase (T16, owner decision 2026-10-08: Codes is the open coding-agent harness; the developer console moved to OpenVibe.Services)
summary: Public at https://openvibe.codes (sudo ovhost deploy codes; unit openvibe-codes on 127.0.0.1:4900). Since 2026-10-08 Codes is the open coding-agent harness: the agent catalog with a public routing API, Improve OpenVibe (every repository and the path to a reviewed pull request) and the community documents. The developer console that used to live here moved to OpenVibe.Services (https://openvibe.services) and every one of its addresses answers a permanent redirect there.
works: Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (authorization code + PKCE S256), session tokens in httpOnly cookies
The agent catalog (server/data/harness-offers.json, validated at boot as platform.harness-offer@1 / platform.agent-offer@1): /harnesses and GET /api/v1/harnesses
Routing a task over the catalog with openvibe-sdk/placement: POST /api/v1/harnesses/route { task, requirements? } → { selected, reasons, candidates }
Improve OpenVibe (/improve): every repository from the pinned contracts' service manifests, and the contributor path
The community documents (code of conduct, contributing, contributor ladder, moderation) rendered from this repository
Permanent redirects for every former console address (301 for reads, 308 for writes) to openvibe.services
robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and llms-full.txt; per-actor and per-address limits; truthful readiness
notYet: Running a task on an agent, streaming its output, budgets (the agents run today on OpenVibe's own machines through ~/openvibe/agents)
Hand-offs between agents and resumable sessions
A runner on a person's own machine (their CLIs, their keys)
Improve OpenVibe as a flow on this site (repository → change → tests → review → pull request); today it is the contributor path on GitHub
The community documents are drafts pending the owner's review
features: redirects for the moved developer console
